description: Calculates UK take-home pay for an employee in tax year 2025/26 or 2026/27 from HMRC's published rates: income tax by band (England, Wales and NI, or the six Scottish bands incl. the 2026/27 Scottish starter and basic bands), employee Class 1 National Insurance (8% / 2%), student loan repayments (Plan 1, 2, 4, 5 and Postgraduate, with 2026/27 thresholds), and pension by salary sacrifice or relief at source. Applies the Personal Allowance taper above £100,000 (£1 per £2, the 60% trap) and reads tax codes such as 1257L, S1257L, K475, BR and D0. Returns net pay a year, a month and a week. Figures copied from gov.uk and HMRC in Oct 2026.

gross_salary.description: Annual gross salary in pounds (GBP), before any deductions.

ni_category.description: National Insurance category letter, default A. C = over State Pension age (no employee NI).

pension_amount.description: Employee pension contribution in pounds a year (gross). Use this OR pension_percent.

pension_method.description: relief_at_source (you pay 80%, provider adds 20%, higher-rate relief claimed back) or salary_sacrifice (cuts pay before tax, NI and student loan). Default salary_sacrifice if a pension is given.

pension_percent.description: Employee pension contribution as a percent of gross salary, e.g. 5. For relief at source this is the gross (grossed-up) contribution.

region.description: Where you live for tax. england, wales, northern_ireland (same bands) or scotland (six Scottish bands). Default england, or taken from an S or C tax code.

student_loan_plans.description: Student loan plans you repay: plan_1, plan_2, plan_4 (Scotland), plan_5, postgraduate. Several are allowed, as gov.uk describes.

tax_code.description: PAYE tax code, default 1257L. Supports nnnnL/M/N/T, S and C prefixes, K codes, BR, D0, D1, SBR, SD0-SD3, 0T, NT and W1/M1/X suffixes.

tax_year.description: UK tax year, 6 April to 5 April. 2025/26 or 2026/27 (default 2026/27).

name: calculate_uk_take_home
title: UK take-home pay
